from collections import Counter
def dots(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.splitlines()
    px=[(r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(10,52) if lines[r][c]=='N']
    cnt = Counter()
    for r,c in px:
        cnt[((r-12)//6,(c-12)//6)] += 1
    return {k:v for k,v in cnt.items() if v>=8}
def gray(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.splitlines()
    px=[(r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(10,52) if lines[r][c]=='g']
    if not px: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in px]; cs=[x[1] for x in px]
    return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2)

# merge 1: click gray marker at (1,5)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':43}])
print('after merge1:', dots(current_frame), 'gray', gray(current_frame))

# select (1,5)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':43}])
print('after select (1,5):', dots(current_frame), 'gray', gray(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
